war_summary: War 139 is on day 85 with no winner and conquest not ended. The front is split: Colonials hold full or near-full control in many regions (Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields, Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast, etc.), while Wardens hold others (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Reaching Trail, Stlican Shelf, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse). The heaviest pressure is concentrated in split or contested zones—Clahstra, Callahans Passage, Callums Cape, Dead Lands, Endless Shore, Godcrofts, Mooring County, Oarbreaker, Olavis Wake, Onyx, Speaking Woods, Stema Landing, and especially Stlican Shelf and Oarbreaker—where casualty rates are high and ownership events are frequent. Several regions show accelerating casualties and enlistments despite cooling in others, and recent capture/loss events within the last 6 hours indicate active base-level fighting. Uncertainty remains high because live population splits are unavailable and enlistment is only a proxy; however, the event history points to Clahstra, Mooring County, Oarbreaker, Stlican Shelf, Onyx, and Olavis Wake as the most volatile for strategic-base ownership shifts in the next 24 hours.
